Good to know

Questions & answers

How far is the beach, and is there parking?

Mala Plaža is 1.1 km away, about a 12-minute walk. Parking is free in our private indoor garage, and your place is kept for you when you come back.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 15:00 to 23:30. Check-out is until 10:00.

Is breakfast included?

It depends on the rate you choose. Ask us when you book and we will tell you what is included.

How do I pay?

Payment is in cash at the villa.

Are pets or parties allowed?

No, pets and parties are not allowed. Quiet hours are from midnight to 07:00.

Which languages do you speak?

Albanian, English, German and Serbian.

Are children welcome?

Yes, children of all ages are welcome. From 3 years old, children pay the adult rate. Cots are available on request, but extra beds are not available.
